howto.title: Three steps, no account
howto.s1b: Use the share button on the video and copy its address.
howto.s2b: Drop it in the field above and press Get video.
howto.s3b: Choose a quality or MP3, trim if you want, and the file saves to your device.

faq.title: Questions people ask
faq.a1: Yes. You get 3 free downloads every hour. The counter resets at the top of the hour.
faq.a2: No. The file streams from the source to your device as it's made. Nothing is saved on our servers.
faq.q3: Why is 4K not offered for some videos?
faq.a3: We only list qualities the source actually has. If it was uploaded in 1080p, that's the top option.
faq.q4: Why does my trimmed clip start a little early?
faq.a4: To keep it fast we cut on keyframes instead of re-encoding, so a clip can start up to about 2 seconds before the time you set.
faq.q5: Where does the file go on iPhone?
faq.a5: Safari saves it to the Files app, in Downloads. From there you can share it to Photos.
faq.a6: Only videos you own or have permission to save. Respect the creator's rights and each site's rules.
faq.q7: How do you make money without ads?
faq.a7: Today we don't. The free plan stays free, and a paid Plus plan for heavy users is planned. We will not add ad networks or pop-ups.
faq.q8: Do I have to install the extension or app?
faq.a8: No. Everything works on this page, at every quality. The extension and app are optional extras that come later.

problem.title: Most downloader sites fight you
problem.p1b: You press Download and get a new tab, a pop-up or an ad instead of your file. Go back, try again, repeat.
problem.p2b: Then comes the extension you must add, or the fake virus warning, before you're allowed HD.
problem.close: Naqi does one thing: you paste a link, you get the file.

features.title: What we promise
features.f1t: No ads, no pop-ups, no new tabs
features.f1b: There are no ad networks on Naqi. One click gives you one file.
features.f2b: 1080p and 4K, when the video has them, right on this page. No quality needs an extension or app.
features.f3b: Private, removed, too long or not available in our region: you see the real reason and what to do next.
features.f4b: No fake virus alerts, no countdowns to rush you, no prizes you've won.
features.f5b: We don't ask who you are. The file streams to your device and isn't stored on our servers.
features.f6b: Set a start and an end and download just that part, or save the sound as MP3.
